frozenBaseline.reason: The baseline is an uncommitted source-tree fingerprint, not a reconstructible git commit. Four small compressed source files preserve the actual oracle without depending on temporary paths or a current-engine fallback.

chosenCandidate.selection: Packed little-endian dense RGBA path plus direct luminance and lazy red cache; original floating-point saturation ratio retained. Source is the measured prototype, not an assertion about a subsequently formatted production tree.

report.scope: Exact complete finish() and live callback differential; both byte array types, unaligned fallback, alpha and black resets, aliases that fork/reconverge, source geometry changes, timestamp gaps and explicit interruption. Numeric buffers only, never rendered.

report.scope: Numeric pushFrame CPU only on one Apple M2 Max, Node v24.19.0; 1920x1080, diagnostics on, 90 frames with 15 excluded warmup, three alternating trials per pair, fresh processes. No capture, conversion, IPC or display/hardware claim. All original pixels and timestamps retained.
report.differential: Each prototype: 126 complete finish/live-callback comparisons against frozen baseline, 1554 findings and callbacks, aligned/unaligned/clamped/alpha/black/aliases/gap/geometry/interruption cases; 8593 packed frames actually used.
report.recommendation: Keep packed+direct as candidate. Reject byte guard (entropy regression). Multiply is exact but too small/inconsistent across workload/trials to justify choosing it over packed+direct in this experiment.

interpretation: Do not combine paired comparisons from different runs as though they were one randomized baseline-versus-final trial. The reusable harness supports a new direct pair against the frozen baseline.
Selected combined variant consistently improved dense entropy and translated-texture processing versus direct-only. These workloads still exceed16.7ms; do not claim sustained60fps.
Gradient, pulse and sparse variants show small/no stable gains and some tail variation. Complete per-frame timing arrays remain available.
Weighted/LUT/RG experiments and the slower byte-reject trial are retained. The exact multiply alternative was not chosen because its small gain was inconsistent.
Differential equality protects current semantics and diagnostics; it does not independently establish normative correctness. External corpus and native browser evidence remain separate.
